assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: Found @TableTest annotation

assertions.text: Email validation and name-required error scenarios are present — at least one row for invalid email and one for missing name.
assertions.evidence: Rows 'Missing name (null)' and 'Invalid email, missing @' etc. present in validatesRegistration table.

assertions.text: Dietary requirements and/or accessibility needs use blank cells (null) when not provided.
assertions.evidence: Rows like 'Missing name (null) | | alice@example.com | | | false | Name is required' show blank Dietary/Accessibility cells.

assertions.text: Irrelevant inputs use value sets or representative values — not blanks — for pricing.
assertions.evidence: Group Size column uses '{5, 20}' value set for group discount rows rather than blanks.

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: First column(s): "Scenario", "Scenario"

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Result?', 'Price?')
assertions.evidence: Question-mark columns: Accepted?, Error Message?, Discount?, Price?

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language.
assertions.evidence: Columns: 'Name | Email | Dietary Requirements | Accessibility Needs | Accepted? | Error Message?' and 'Registration Date | Group Size | Discount? | Price?'

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes.
assertions.evidence: Pricing scenario names 'No discount applies', 'Early-bird discount applies', 'Group discount applies' describe outcomes rather than conditions.

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: 2 method(s) checked — no if/switch/ternary

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
assertions.evidence: Annotations in correct order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 2 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: Multiple tables/@TableTest methods each addressing a distinct concern.
assertions.evidence: Two methods: 'validatesRegistration' and 'calculatesPricingAndDiscount'.

assertions.text: Each table has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules.
assertions.evidence: Validation table rows test only name/email/optional fields; pricing table rows test only date/group size, no cross-multiplication.

assertions.text: Input validation and pricing/discount calculation are in separate @TableTest methods.
assertions.evidence: validatesRegistration() and calculatesPricingAndDiscount() are distinct methods with distinct tables.

assertions.text: Validation @TableTest includes Dietary Requirements and Accessibility Needs columns with both null and non-null rows.
assertions.evidence: 'Valid with optional fields | Bob | bob@example.com | Vegetarian | Wheelchair access | true' alongside blank rows.

assertions.text: Registration date uses descriptive values with a @TypeConverter method.
assertions.evidence: 'before cutoff'/'on cutoff'/'after cutoff' rows with '@TypeConverter public static LocalDate parseRegistrationDate(String value)'.

assertions.text: If registration dates are literal, the early-bird cutoff date appears as a separate policy column...
assertions.evidence: Table uses descriptive 'before cutoff'/'on cutoff'/'after cutoff' values converted via @TypeConverter, not literal dates.

assertions.text: @Description does not include information already visible in the table columns or derivable from the table structure...
assertions.evidence: "Base price is £100. Early-bird registrations (before 2025-03-01) get 20% off; groups of 5 or more get 15% off..." states constants/thresholds fixed in the method body and clarifies scope (validation covered separately), matching the allowed categories.

assertions.text: Output column is 'Discount?' rather than 'Price?'...
assertions.evidence: Table header: "Scenario | Registration Date | Group Size | Discount? | Price?" — Discount? is present as the primary output.

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method applies one uniform assertion pattern to every row — not different assertions per scenario. Several unconditional assertions checking distinct observable outputs of one result (e.g. success, message, resulting cart) count as one uniform pattern; the anti-pattern is branching on the row (if/switch/ternary/try-catch) to choose what is asserted.
assertions.evidence: 2 method(s) apply one uniform assertion pattern to all rows

assertions.text: The optional-fields acceptance table includes an expectation/output column...
assertions.evidence: Validation table header includes "Accepted? | Error Message?" asserting acceptance for each combination.

assertions.text: Scenario names and @Description text do not restate values the table already shows.
assertions.evidence: Scenario names like 'Missing name (null)', 'Both apply, early-bird wins' do not repeat literal cell values; descriptions state thresholds (£100, 2025-03-01, 5) that are fixed constants, not restating varying column data.

assertions.text: The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit as a test dependency
assertions.evidence: Build file contains tabletest-junit

assertions.text: Cell values make the rule falsifiable, not merely distinguishable.
assertions.evidence: Discount? values vary across rows (0.00, 20.00, 15.00) and Accepted? varies (true/false), so a fixed-output implementation would fail some rows.

assertions.text: A reader can state the rule from the table alone, without the test method body.
assertions.evidence: "Base price is £100. Early-bird registrations (before 2025-03-01) get 20% off; groups of 5 or more get 15% off..." gives thresholds/rates in the @Description, and column headers name the operations.

assertions.text: The generated test code compiles successfully against the project scaffolding
assertions.evidence: Compilation succeeded

assertions.text: When a title or description quantifies over a domain, the rows must actually cover that domain.
assertions.evidence: "Group discount applies" row uses Group Size value set '{5, 20}' covering the '5 or more' domain, and 'Both apply, early-bird wins' row demonstrates the never-stack claim.
